programme.title: Concrete Utopia [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: The world has been reduced to rubble by a massive earthquake. While no one knows for sure how far the ruins stretch, or what the cause of the earthquake may be, in the heart of Seoul there is only one apartment building left standing. It is called Hwang Gung Apartments. As time passes, outsiders start coming in to Hwang Gung Apartments trying to escape the extreme cold. Before long, the apartment residents are unable to cope with the increasing numbers. Feeling a threat to their very survival, the residents enact a special measure.

programme.title: THE GREAT WAR OF ARCHIMEDES [English Dub]
programme.desc: It is the early 1930s and the command of the Japanese Imperial Navy determines to construct the world's biggest and most formidable battleship, Yamato. One of the admirals, Yamamoto Isoroku, disagrees. He recruits the upstart and mathematics' expert Tadashi Kai who discovers there are discrepancies between the official cost estimates and the actual figures. They soon find out that they have stumbled upon a conspiracy.

programme.title: Oh Lucy! [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Bored Tokyo lady Setsuko (Independent Spirit Award-nominee Shinobu Terajima) breaks free of her monotonous life when her niece, Mika (Shioli Kutsuna) convinces her to enroll in an unorthodox English class. There, she adopts a blonde-haired alter ego name 'Lucy' and develops romantic feelings for her American instructor, John (Josh Hartnett).But after his sudden disappearance, Setsuko follows his trail halfway around the world to Southern California, where family ties and past lives are tested as she struggles to fulfill the promise of 'Lucy.'

programme.title: 200 Pounds Beauty [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Han-na is a large girl with a warm heart, who also has an unbelievable voice. She wants to become a pop-singer, but because she is unattractive, she’s only given opportunities to ghost-sing for a popular singer named Amy. Han-na is also in love with Amy’s producer, Sang-joon, but Sang-joon doesn’t notice her. One day, Han-Na is invited to Sang-Joon’s birthday party and receives a red dress from him to wear to his party. But at the party when she runs into Amy in the same red dress, Han-na is embarrassed with herself and disappears. 1 year later, Han-na returns as the beautiful Jenny.

programme.title: The Gangster, The Cop, The Devil
programme.desc: Gang boss Jang and Detective Jung join forces to hunt down a serial killer named 'K'.

programme.title: Ditto [English Dub]
programme.desc: A story about the love and friendship that takes place in an era where a man and a woman communicate through radio by chance.

programme.title: The Informant [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Detective O Nam-hyeok, a spectacularly inept cop clinging to his badge by a thread. When a botched sting operation lands him in hot water, he's forced to partner with Cho Tae-bong, a razor-sharp informant whose cover and savings are blown by Nam-hyeok's bumbling. With a smuggling ring to bust and zero trust between them, this mismatched duo must navigate double-crosses, bruised egos, and their own chaotic partnership while taking down a criminal organization.

programme.title: Project Y [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Two women, friends and of the same age Mi Seon and Do Gyeong, might be used to struggling in the most dangerous part of Seoul's Gangnam district, but that doesn't mean they've settled into it. With no one but each other to rely on, the two friends grind away to save the money needed to leave their dangerous lifestyles behind. But just as “retirement” comes within reach, the world betrays them, shattering their hopes. On the edge of a dead end, they discover a hidden fortune of dirty cash and gold in Gangnam – and place all their bets on one final high-stakes gamble of a lifetime. They make an audacious plan to steal $6 million USD in gold bars and flee from the area.

programme.title: IP MAN 1 [English Dub]
programme.desc: A semi-biographical account of Yip Man, the first martial arts master to teach the Chinese martial art of Wing Chun. The film focuses on events surrounding Ip that took place in the city of Foshan between the 1930s to 1940s during the Second Sino-Japanese War. Directed by Wilson Yip, the film stars Donnie Yen in the lead role, and features fight choreography by Sammo Hung.

programme.title: IP MAN 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Having defeated the best fighters of the Imperial Japanese army in occupied Shanghai, Ip Man and his family settle in post-war Hong Kong. Struggling to make a living, Master Ip opens a kung fu school to bring his celebrated art of Wing Chun to the troubled youth of Hong Kong. His growing reputation soon brings challenges from powerful enemies, including pre-eminent Hung Gar master, Hung Quan.

programme.title: Warrior King [English Dub]
programme.desc: In this epic true story inspired by the legend of King Gesar, a young man grows up in exile in a world overrun by demons and monsters. When evil forces threaten his home, he returns to save his people and embrace his destiny as great hero and ruler.

programme.title: Ashfall [English Dub]
programme.desc: In the face of a disaster that will engulf both North and South Korea, a mission is put into action to stop a super volcanic eruption.

programme.title: The Wandering Earth 2 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Humans built huge engines on the surface of the earth to find a new home. But the road to the universe is perilous. In order to save earth, young people once again have to step forward to start a race against time for life and death.
